messages:
morgan: Heads up — during the 04:00-05:00 change window the canary we split 10/90 showed ~25% of traffic hitting the canary in the console.
raj: Wait really? Was the deploybot override triggered?
morgan: deploy-bot posted a pause and then a fallback to baseline model. I saved the screenshot.
elena: I think this is the 'metered-split' smoothing kicking in when quota counters reset at the hour. The routing policy hash + quota clamp can over-allocate.
deploy-bot: Deploy Bot: paused rollout r1402 for project/lexicon; reason: quota-exhaustion-delta > 0.1, fallback applied.
sre_oncall: @morgan can you paste the rollout config? esp the traffic policy and quota window.
morgan: here's the route config used:
```yaml
rollout: canary-r1402
split: 0.1
policy:
  type: percentile-hash
  smoothing: metered
quotas:
  per_minute: 12000
  reset_alignment: hour
```
raj: ahh reset_alignment: hour — that aligns with metrics reset at :00 and smoothing uses the last-minute backlog.
uiux: console only shows 'intended_split' right now. We need an 'observed_split' timeseries and a flag when deploy-bot falls back.
elena: agree. Also the telemetry needs to report 'effective_route' (policy+quota applied) so we can see when routing differs from configured.
morgan: Action: raj + uiux to add observed_split and fallback flag to rollout dashboard. elena + sre_oncall to check if smoothing algo needs change (consider minute-aligned reset). I'll follow up with a quick postmortem.
raj: noted, will prototype a dashboard overlay in the next PR.
uiux: I'll mock the new panel — want the observed split as rolling 1m/5m/15m.
sre_oncall: reassigning incident to eng-runtime, tagging r1402, and archiving deploy-bot logs.
morgan: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
